current_range.encoding: uint4 expanded by official driver binding to one uint8 per sample; raw range codes retained

onset_definition: First >=20mA sample within500ms before phase1, with prior1ms average absolute level<100uA; not independently measured power-good.
interpretation_limits: Native amplitudes, negative current and input-voltage extremes remain observations, not proof of physical DUT inrush or clipping.
Fixed range removes ongoing autoranging but does not independently calibrate startup, insertion effects, clipping or source/target voltage separation.
Current range samples are aligned by native sample_id, not callback order; the current stream starts earlier than range/voltage/power.
Range-code transition proximity does not by itself prove the transient is an instrument artifact.
Whole-session initial NaNs remain; scoped windows are finite. No independent SD readback is claimed by this analyzer.
